meta.title: Weather canon, tier 1: capital and largest city of every country (Earth)
meta.source: NASA POWER monthly climatology (MERRA-2); temperatures adjusted to the place's real elevation at 6.5 C per km; elevations from Open-Meteo (Copernicus DEM)
meta.units: Every number is a whole number. Temperatures in c (Celsius), f (Fahrenheit) and k (Kelvin). Rain in mm, snow in cm, wind in km/h, humidity in percent.
meta.pending: For places not yet upgraded: snowCm, rainDays, frostNights, peakWindKmh, gustRecordKmh and heaviestRainDayMm are null until Open-Meteo detail is pulled; avgWindKmh is the average speed, not the daily peak; recordHigh and recordLow are the hottest and coldest 2 m readings the model shows in the 20 years, taken hourly, so a true station record can be a degree or two more extreme. Places with dataSource open-meteo-era5 already have full detail and daily-based records.
meta.caveats: For places not yet upgraded, lowConfidenceTemps marks places where the elevation adjustment is more than 3 C, mostly mountain and coastal-cliff cities. Largest city comes from GeoNames populations with hand fixes and is still to be spot-checked.
